title.narrative: Reducing TB incidence and TB related mortality among Somalis - Somalia (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Somalia, Tuberculosis, World Vision International (WVI Somalia)This program has the following goals: Reduce the incidence of TB (all forms) by 50% by 2025 and 90% by 2035 (from 2015 baseline figure). The objectives of this program are: Increase TB treatment coverage (case detection ratio) to 54% by 2020 (from baseline of 47% in 2015). Increase treatment success to at least 90% in all forms of detected non-MDR TB cases. Increase annual case detection of MDR- TB to 700 by 2020 (from baseline of 243 in 2016) and improve management of MDR-TB cases through country-wide implementation of the shorter MDR-TB treatment regimen. Ensure that 100% of new staff receive induction training and that 50% of TB service facilities receive regular supervision and monitoring by 2022
